comment: The order in which ROR's institutions outside the US fill institutions-global.json's 900 KiB budget (docs/design/core.md §5.1). The build takes, country by country in this order, first the records with a Wikipedia link, then the rest, each country's records by ROR id, and stops at the first record that would not fit. Countries not listed are never included. The order puts English-speaking job markets and the countries most US applicants studied in first; review it with the owner.
